name: Nerin
source:
Nerin – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
A young obsidian-scaled om'verai, with his body covered in interlocking scales that shimmer with streaks of crimson and silver. Long, curved horns arc back from its head, framing a pair of glowing violet eyes. A mane of bladed spines runs down its neck and shoulders. His wings, vast and veined like molten glass.
Due to isolation, Nerin is a shy child, staying near his mother most of times, as well as being easy-to-offend. Since Nerin is a small kid, it is not so hard to win his trust. Nerin is afraid of a big amount of people around due to lack of communication outside his home.
